reviewText: Home Slice serves great New York style pizza with a variety of super fresh ingredients. Even though the pizza is the main focus, the salads, desserts and wines are also surprisingly delicious.  I would recommend eating in because the servers are friendly and overall vibe is dark and cozy (also I think the dine-in pizza actually tastes better than the carry-out). If there's a wait, go to the backyard, get drinks and play ping pong.   Basically, it's hard to go wrong with this place. Tasty pizza, excellent service, cool vibe.
you're not going to find a better spot for pizza in town. you're just not.

When I've had Home Slice delivery, it's been phenomenal, but when I went in (Home Slice 2) is was average- perhaps the pie was overcooked, I'm not sure. Staff was friendly and the atmosphere is good for the kids.
Definitely one of the best pizza places I have been to.  Once it touches your tongue will agree with me haha
One of my favorite pizza spots in Austin.  Great location right on SOCO
Great pizza, crust is what makes it delicious. The sauce is so-so but toppings are fresh and service is great.
Great pizza, love the white pizza to go.
I love Home Slice! The Margherita pizza is AMAZING!!!
Great pizza place.  A bit pricey for pizza, but worth it.  Beware of the long lines.  Great place for a celebration.
Does not take long and it is really worth it.  Plus it is fun to shop around South Congress

Having lived in Brooklyn NY and worked in a local pizzeria. .. I give this place a 5 star rating. AMAZING atmosphere and friendly people. this should be a must on your list if you are visiting Austin. We got the medium pepperoni and it was to die for.

1 word: margarita. It's legit New York pizza too. I met one of their servers and apparently the cooks learn to make the pizza by literally going to pizza joints in NYC. Actually after loving in NY for 2 years I'd say it's even better than most margarita slices in NY, they have this rubbery mozzarella cheese there that just doesn't work. But Homeslice has the perfect balance of fresh cheese, Roma's, garlic, EVOO, and BASIL. Really the shredded basil makes it. This place is über local and über tasty. But make sure you try and make it during non-tradition  dining hours because its always PACKED. Great spot though.
They are the best... It took me a while to find a slice like my home town... Finally, someone hit the nail on the head. Try the Italian sub too!

om nom nom pizza.  Home Slice has some of the best pizza in Austin. Fresh ingredients. Thin crust. Best part is they opened More Home Slice next door and now you can get a slice even if you're in a rush.  Home Slice is notorious for its long waits any time, so I haven't been to Home Slice in about six months. But I stop by More Home Slice about once a week to get my pizza fix.  Try a slice of mushroom and pepperoni if they have 'em with a house salad. Yum!
The best pizza for the nights you cant remember! ;)
Really good pizza, cool atmosphere.  Tough to get a table at times, but I definitely would recommend going when you can get slices.
I come from NJ.  We have thin crust pizza there.  I moved to Texas.  I missed it terribly.  I found Home Slice Pizza!  I am happy again :-)
Excellent pizza if you feel like braving some long lines. Don't let them deter you. They have very speedy service!

My fiance and I had a good experience at Home Slice Pizza. The pizza was tasty and the staff was friendly. It was not the best pizza I've ever had but it did the job and made us happy. If you are looking for a quick affordable piece of pizza I would not suggest this place as we found the prices to be rather high.
While it is ALWAYS packed, it is totally worth the wait! Hands down the best pizza I have ever had! And the spinach salad is amazing!

Want to experience Austin at it's best? Homeslice on Congress is a MUST! Just FYI come early if you plan on eating in the evening... but totally worth the wait. Full from eating so much take a stroll down Congress and swing by to Amy's ice cream.
don't get it. been there 2 times and the service was SO BAD and the pizza was just meh. Why is this such a HUGE deal?
LOVED this pizza. Amazing atmosphere, and the pizza is just damned good. There is good reason for this place being hella mega popular in Austin.
Great pizza and beer!  If you go after the bars shut down, you'll be waiting a while, but it's worth it if you can stick it out.
Delicious pizza for an affordable price. Nice atmosphere with speedy service. convenient location in the center of Austin.
AMAZING pizza, fun atmosphere.  Indoor and outdoor seating.. great area of Austin.  Would definitely go back!

Hands down the best pizza in town. Usually a long wait but so worth it. I am a huge fan of the classic, mushroom and pepperoni. The take out next door is a good way to skip some of the wait, but only if you call ahead.

one of my favorite places to get pizza here in town. The crust is always crispy and perfect and always worth the wait. Ohh and you have to get the garlic knots while you're there they might just be the best part.
Friendly staff,  and quick service. I liked that we were able to see how our pizza was made. Huge tourist attraction because of its location, make sure to get there with enough time.
Good pies.  Good atmosphere.  Great times. But crowded.
Fantastic Pizza! My favorite place in town.

I don't even know what to type here. 5 stars doesn't begin to describe Home Slice. Some of the best New York style thing crust pizza available in town. Be aware, this place is closed on Tuesday! There is also More Home Slice next door that only sells a few types of pie and pizza by the slice if you want a quick bite. Same great pizza.
It was great! Good food!Great place to take families and hangout! Had alot of fun !
Great Margherita Pizza with really fresh ingredients!!!!!
Worth the hour wait i promise!!!!
Yummy in my Tummy! No Pineapples here though. Sometimes parking is hard to find.

I went for my friend's birthday and later on a date and both times the food was excellent, the service was speedy and top notch, and the decor is perfect for a pizza place. I am definitely looking forward to going again soon.
The Margherita is good, but everything else I've tried is a flop. Simple is better and a few of the options are too rich. Keep with Italian tradition - let the natural ingradients do the talking.
The pies are really great. Some great slices are Margherita and Meatball and Onion. It's a really great neighborhood pizza joint.
Love this place so much.
My favorite pizza in Austin. Consistently delicious! Plus the late night hours is great. Friendly staff also
I have grown to love this place. the staff is awesome and its the white pizza i love the best! best to go mid day or late night.
Great service. If you don't want to wait around go to the pick up window next door. The crust is just right.

This is my very favorite pizza place in Austin!! It is absolutely amazing! However, it is alnost always very busy so be prepared to wait a while. But don't let that stop you because this place is totally worth the wait.

Though I did enjoy my one slice I've had here, I don't get it.  I don't understand how there is always such a long line for this establishment.  It was good, but nothing to rave about. OOOOhhh wow, they use Artichoke hearts with spinach, how novel!  If anything, the reason the lines are always so long is because they are slow as anything to serve you one slice.  I went in here when there was no one else here and it still took 15-20 min for one slice to come out.    So despite being the rave of the town, I just don't get it.  The hype was not worth it and I may or may not return here.  But if i do, i will be expecting very little and I doubt I will be disappointed with that analysis.
pretty mediocre pizza - doesn't live up to all the hype. if you're in a bind, it'll hit the spot, but it's not going to satisfy any major pizza cravings.
This place is definitely worth the long wait.  The pizza here is great!   I try to go here as frequently as possible, even if I only take out.
Cool place.  Very friendly employees.  Badass pizza.  Child-friendly, but loud. Usually has a long wait but is worth it!
Pepperoni and sausage cheese pie is delicious!
They have some awesome Pizza but arrive early on the weekends or be patient

If you can master the long wait (which I have!), this place is perfect. Fast if you want, slow if you have the time, wine list with just enough options and the pizza and other foods reliably delicious. I can never go too much.

This is THE BEST PIZZA in austin.  Our family prefers More Home Slice which is right next door.  No need to wait in a line to sit, just order your pizza and sit in the street with the rest of your family.  I find that homeslice is a great place to hit before going downtown, or just a great place to pick up pizza and walk around.  Again this is a MUST place for people to go!

Home slice is this hip pizza dive on south congress. The atmosphere is just one of the many attractions to the place. Once in this true austin tx treasure the waiters are full of the southern  hospitality. Not even mentioning the awesome pizza that you can make your way.
I know it's very popular and has delicious food, but personally I find the pizza way too salty.
Some of the best pie in town.  So many options now in Austin but Home Slice is definitely near the top.  Great by the slice or a whole pie with friends. Get it by the slice or by the pie.
My favorite slice in the city. I'd consider myself a pizza purist; crust NY style, with the right amount of chew. Cheese has a great stretch as well.
The best Pizza that I have had since I left NY

Phenomenal Food!  Great Service!  Fantastic Atmosphere!  Well worth however long you need to wait for a table.  Their pizza is always top quality, the garlic knots divine and sandwiches stellar.  Personal fan of the Anti-Pasta platter!

Everyone knows the pizza is great here, but not as many folks tell you about their excellent salads? The House "side" (a good sized portion) salad, comes chock full of shredded carrots, red onion, red cabbage, tomatoes, and peppers, and it comes with a melt-in-your-mouth garlic knot.  The pear and gorgonzola salad, with walnuts, is also quite delicious. Either side salad, combined with a slice of the Margherita pizza, is The PERFECT lunch!  And who doesn't love the freebie Smarties that comes in the jar with your bill?
So city driving is pretty hard for most people, but not me i use google maps and it takes me there perfectly. Never using a iphone map again!!!
Best pizza and amazing location! Recommend buying a slice then crossing the street to Guero's and washing it down with a cold beer while listening to live music!
yummy pizza for a great price.
Best pizza in Austin, make sure you are willing to wait in line forever.. but its totally worth it! Oh, and the pizza is HOT! So wait a sec before taking a bite.
I love this place, it's amazing! The service is excellent and everyone is super nice. I will be back soon!
Home Slice is really fun because they have a ping pong table. Mr. Mark is the best waiter and is super fun. They are always so nice to me and my sister when we go eat there.
Simply the best pizza in Austin. It's open until 3am most nights (great to pick up a pie after 6th). I enjoy this pizza just as much if not more than NYC pizza :))
Great food and drinks. I had the meat calzone and my wife a couple of different slices. Very filling meal!
They have great pizzas. It"s the best between Austin and New York.
Great Pizza!!

Okay, I absolutely LOVE homeslice pizza! I typically hate pizza because I hate tomatoes. I'm weird, I know. I recommend getting the Margherita pizza. It is to die for. The crust is the perfect amount of crunchy. On the Margherita, they use white sauce, chopped tomatoes and shredded basil. It's odd that they use no red sauce but I think it's better that way.   give it a try, and stop by MORE homeslice because the line is ridiculously long... or just go at an odd hour (not lunch and dinner time.)

Home Slice produces excellent pizza. If you closed your eyes with a piece folded in your hands you might think you were transported to the Big Apple. Definitely a must for out of towners or for those transplants from New York who want to enjoy a little slice of home.
A must have after a late night.
Pizza literally as big as your head! Great location, within walking distance of all the must see attractions in Austin.

Homemade pizza. Unique combinations. A walk-up window where you can by beer and individual slices. Home Slice is one of the first places any tourist should check out as they roam the awesome street of South Congress.

Home Slice is an Austin Icon. Quality pizza, quality ingredients and decent service. Located in SoCo (South Congress) the restaurant has a nice outdoor patio section as well behind the restaurant. They only serve "traditional" pizza according to them so don't bother asking for a ham and pineapple pizza as this is not an option. Overall you won't be disappointed with the classic pizza that comes from Home Slice, it is a place that every Austinite who loves pizza should visit.
NY-style pizza, big delicious floppy slices of amazing.
i love their pizza! the slices are so big and the pizza is just amazing and  the service her is just good.
The crust was airy, in a nonsatisfying way.   The ingredients were great, and the noncrust portion of the pizza was good, but the crust was super disappointing.
Good atmosphere.  Perfect place to eat on a Saturday afternoon while shopping.
Favorite pizza place in Austin.  The egg plant pizza is phenomenal!  Service is always fast and friendly!
If your just walking around congress and wanting a quick bit Home Slice is perfect. Great taste. Great service.
Amazing Pizza!

I like pizza. I mean, wouldn't you agree that it's pretty much the best? Unfortunately, Home Slice Pizza did not quite deliver (which I mean figuratively...not sure if they have delivery service). I waited to be seated much longer than the hosts estimated. That's okay; it was a rainy night and the other diners were probably just taking their time. However, the reason for the two stars is the the crust was dry. Dry, dry, dry.  Like I said, I like pizza. I am sort of an equal opportunity pizza consumer. I am not a snob and will nom on all kinds of pizza--from cheap convenience store pizza to a thick Chicago pie to Costco's massive pizza! That said, I don't think I would do Home Slice again.

Hands down, the best pizza in Austin. If you're ever in town, and you enjoy pizza, then you must eat here at least once. I don't even like mushrooms, but I have to recommend you try the pepperoni mushroom pizza; it's my personal favorite!

home slice has almost perfect tasting pizza. their service was also very good. the waiters were quick to take our order and bring our food.i usually go with my mom. it is also very family friendly. it is easy quick and good.

Best New York-style pizza I've ever had- And I'm not from Texas! My initial experiences were with the 'More Home Slice' location that's next door and just serves slices- I really love the margherita, though the white pie is especially tasty. The slices are HUGE- even though it's thin-crust, you definitely wouldn't need more than 2 slices. I love their little neon sign outside, too. For those who don't know how to eat NY-style pizza, they give you a little pictorial in the menu, which I found to be pretty special of them. I also want to buy basically all of their tshirts, which they have displayed inside the sit-down space.
This place is really cool. I love the atmosphere, food, and staff. Definitely my go to pizza place.
I definitely recommend the eggplant pizza. It's pretty unique and tasty.

You have to check out this place, the food is top notch and delicious. I keep coming back for more very time I give tour guides to friends that are visiting and when I'm not hosting as well. Check it out for yourself, you won't be disappointed.
Great prices per slice and fairly fast to get the pie.  I had the garlic and sausage and was impressed by the flavor and value.
It's good, but not to the extent people rave about. Maybe it's cause I've never seen the fuss over NY style pizza, but this is definitely not worth waiting in line for.
Best pizza experience I've had in a very long time. Orgazmic- some would say.
Unbelievable marinara sauce!  Iconic Landmark for Austin, Love you guy's!
Quick and delicious the only issue we had was the limited amount of seating.

Are you on South Congress? Do you need awesome pizza RIGHT NOW? Well, Sir or Madam, you are in luck because this you just hit the pizza jackpot. We're talking world-class pizza, in your face, you can't handle this. Okay, you can handle this but don't blame me when your socks are somewhere across the street because they've been BLOWN OFF.
Incredible atmosphere, cold beer, and great pizza!
I love how all the slices are big, I really like the margerita and the pepperoni one! This is also one of the local favorite spot to eat. The price is reasonable and you don't have to wait very long.
If you're in Austin you HAVE to visit Home Slice, the pizzas are creative and delicious and the service is really friendly and cool.
Best Pizza's in town. We really love their Pizza's and eat here often.
Delicious pizza! The staff was great when we visited.
I Love their pizza!!!!

The pizza is solid, but nowhere near up to par with House Pizzeria up north. But that's ok, it's not supposed to be. I wish they had more non pizza dishes, like mozzarella sticks or wings. Garlic knots just don't cut it.
Austin staple. Best pizza on south congress.
best pizza in the world. always meet great ppl since the place is small. but never a bad time.

Hands down best pizza in Austin. I stopped eating pizza else where after trying this place. Don't forget to try their Cherry Peppers as topping if you like spicy stuff. Their wait times are insane, but the wait is usually worth it. The wait is not that boring since you can hang out at the back playing ping pong, and having a beer.

I've never been a fan of pizza until I ate here. I always order their caesar salad, since they make it like a true caesar salad should be made, with real anchovies. I never really order their specialty pizzas because their pepperoni and mushroom just do it for me.

Great. Great crust. Great toppings. Great Service. Great Vibe. Even though the place was busy, staff was quick; noticing we were only two they offered to sit us right away at the bar. Had two slices and couldve had another!
I've only tried slices, not whole pies. But I've found this pizza to be just ok - and not really NY-style. Which is fine for most people. I just prefer NY-style.
Love this place! My fav pizza joint in Austin! Ever time I make it downtown I have to stop here! Everything that I've tried is great but cheese has to be my fav!

Home slice is a modern minimalistic restaurnt that serves some of the best pizza in all of Austin. Anyone coming into downtown wether they are visiting or are an Austin resident will find the resturaunt to be and excellent choice if you want a quick bite to eat. The pizza is excellent and the slices are large and all at a low cost! I will continue to go back anytime im looking for a good slice of pizza.

Great service. The new building with the slice line really allows people to move in and out of the place a lot faster than it used to and the roasted red pepper, ricotta cheese, and sausage pizza is to die for. Highly recommended to anyone with a developed sense of taste.
Amazing pizza! The crust is yummy and the toppings are so fresh. One of the best pizza places in Austin.
Cheap, great food with a great atmosphere. Normally a wait but if it's nice outside then sit at the pull up bar out front.
Good pizza. You can taste the freshness of ingredients. A huge plus, even if you order pick-up or to-go, you can still get a six pack or bottle of wine! :)
Probably the best damn pizza in Austin. I go for lunch fairly often and am very happy with the pepperoni pizza. This is a must-visit Austin place!
Very friendly staff. My girlfriend and I felt not only taken care of but appreciated for our business. That's a nice thing to feel from a pizza by the slice joint!  The pizza was superb as well.
Home Slice is my personal favorite pizza place in Austin.  Great location, amazing pizza, and cheap wine.  This might be the only pizza place in town that it would be ok to take a date to.

Another place which fits perfectly on SOCO. this is a place which catches the spirit of austin. its a great place to hang out with the friends or family, but it can get super crowded on week nights. and once i had a pizza there that was drowning in grease, but that doesn't mean you shouldn't go because the pizza is great!
Great Pizza!! Best in town!!
Great pizza totally recommend to everyone

If you love New York pizza, you don't have to go any further north than South Congress.  This is a real thing...big hot slices dripping with olive oil.  A crust that even I, who never eats the crust, can leave on my plate.   Whether you eat a slice at the walk-up, or head next door for a sit-down lunch or dinner, when you're at Home Slice, your in New York.
This is a great place to come and enjoy a slice of pizza or a whole pie... it does get crowded but do not let this stop you... its totally worth the wait!

The pepperoni and mushroom pizza at Home Slice hits the spot every time I get it.  Sometimes I will get the calzone but that is a lot of food (still very delicious).  If you want to get away from the monotonous routine of papa johns, dominos, or pizza hut - hit up home slice.  You will enjoy every bite with a big smile on your face.
Pizza was so good, won't find any place like that back at home.

It's pretty good. I think the location and the cool branding do a lot for them. I don't know about you, but I just like saying "Home Sliiiiiiiice". There's lots of good pizza in Austin, but Home Slice provides a fun experience too.

Home Slice pizza is literally; amazing. As you enter you can smell the delicious smell of pizza dough being made and the chattering of  happy people. Austin hosts so many good food places and Home Slice has got to be one of the best. Thanks for being so awesome! Keep it rolling!

This is the best pizza in Austin.  I love to grab a slice on the go, drink on the back patio, and I take everyone who comes to visit here!  It is a pizza joint everyone should try!  It's all around a good place to go to eat!
if it's good enough for Lance Armstrong, it's good enough for me and my two balls.
pretty awesome pizza, its some of the best i've had in austin. the service there was great as well, very friendly atmosphere.
great pizza
Amazing pizza and MOST certainly worth the wait. Service was good! Definitely enjoyed my time here!

A couple of my friends and I went to home slice pizza and shared one large pepperoni pizza with cherry peppers. The pizza was great, very New York style and the taste was better than average. In total we paid around 25 including drinks. For 3 people this was probably the best price for an entire pizza. I would definitely recommend this place to everyone that loves pizza.
HAnds Down best pizza in town.
Best pizza in town. I love their magherita pizza. Get an order of garlic knots or "snakes on a plane" as they are referred to by employees.
Not bad.

Don't buy into the hype. This place is below average and in a place like Austin that just won't cut it.   I was there 7/9/08 at 9pm and was told that the way on a pie was 30 minutes. Not bad, but I can deal with it. I order, and notice that they use Roma products and were charging $12 for a medium with no toppings...   If you know anything about the restaurant biz you know that Roma is low-end. Anyway, at 10:15 I checked up on my order and was told it had just gone into the oven.. .at 10:30 I asked again and was told it was almost done. It takes exactly 5 minutes to cook a pizza... they were lying to me. Then when I finally went inside instead of dealing with the window I saw my pizza in a box with my name on top of the over. I asked the guy how long it had been there... he said (about 20 minutes). AVOID THIS PLACE. If you're drunk and you want by the slice then whatever, but do NOT eat at this place. Save your money for Austin's Pizza or Pizza Nizza.
Love this place. Just the perfect amount of grease dripping down each slice. Mmmm!
Great pizza good people lots of fun!!!!  Try the mushroom and pepperoni pizza its to die for
My favorite pizza ever!  You can't find a better slice anywhere else in Austin.  Crust is perfect.  I am a regular!
This place is an awesome place. Staff is always friendly. Pizza is better than Digorno!

As a displaced New Yorker, I am one of the pickiest pizza eaters around and I have to say Home Slice delivers. From the thin crispy crust, plentiful toppings, to slightly moody staff, I feel just at home! They also have a pretty darn tasty Italian salad.
I like the mustaches
It, was awesome!
When of my favorite places to get pizza!!!!  Friendly people good beer and inexpensive.

Best pizza pie in Austin without a doubt. Crisp thin crust pizza with a variety of toppings that have an original flair to it. My favorite is the sausage ricotta: gobs of fresh ricotta paired with chunks of sausage and roasted peppers that explode in your mouth. It's crowded and the pies take a while, so if you can't wait you can just go through the take out window for a single slice. Less choice but you're in and out.
Sausage and Onion 4 life
Their pizza is awesome!! The slices are bigger than Sam's club and they come out nice and fresh, it may burn your mouth but the pain is worth it for this pizza.

If you're ever in Austin (the greatest city on earth) you should definatly stop by Home Slice. By far the best pizza in Austin, the cheese will melt in your mouth and the sauce is like red sauce from heaven. The line is long, so come early but its totally worth it. Stop by Home Slice whenever you can on SoC. Keep Austin Weird.

It's not my favorite NY style pizza in town, but it's never disappointing. The service can vary but is usually pretty good. I very much prefer getting it to go, as it's something I enjoy more at home.
I'm a huge fan of Home Slice. The smell of cooking pizzas waft up and down South Congress and draw you in. These pizzas don't make you feel terrible after you've eaten a slice.
Hands down the best pizza in Austin.  I am from the east coast and consider myself a pizza snob.  Home Slice has got it down when it comes to a great pie!
Every time I go to Home Slice I am never disappointed. The Pizza is the closet you can get to real N.Y. Pizzas. I always take anyone who is visiting here to eat! :)
Some of the best pizza I've ever had. Some interesting kinds of pizza too such as eggplant.
Best pizza in town!
love the pizza and has a nice patio

If you're strolling through South Congress, Home Slice is the place to go! Though the wait is fairly awful on the weekends, if you're able to beat the rush, then you are in the clear! All of their pizzas are hand made and uniquely crafted for the Austin Crowd. Personally, my favorites range from the classic Pepperoni Mushroom to the Margarita pizza. The waiters are awesome, and are very interactive with their tables. It's a great place to hang out on the weekend!
Although I've only dined in twice this is my ultimate spot for take home pizza. It is different. It is better. I appreciate the fresh ingredients and the dough handling. It truly makes a difference.
One of the top two best pizza places in Austin (only other contender is Hoboken Pies).  It's yum
The veggie pizza here is great!  This is my favorite pizza place in Austin!
Best pizza I have found yet in Texas. The staff is friendly and the atmosphere of the area is wonderful! The price is on par with the quality.

Home Slice Pizzs is so yummy, they had to open a second location right next door.  And it's still always packed!  Every now and then I swing by for a single slice, but I usually order a pie to pick up and take away.  My favorite is the #4: Spinach, roasted red pepper, green olives, and onions.  It's so delicious, you'll never miss the meat.  Their sandwiches are super satisfying as well--try the whole Italian Assorted, which is large enough to share with a friend, and add hot cherry peppers because you have to!
I really enjoy their Margherita pizza. The line can get long for the walk-up window, but you can sometimes avoid that line by ordering inside. A lot of people don't realize that.

Great Pizza, although I wouldn't wait in line for it.  The Spinach Feta Pizza was very good, a little salty.  The best part of the experience was watching them hand toss a pizza .  Here's a video http://youtu.be/r3Sxo3O-bMs I would suggest sitting at the bar to enjoy it.  They kept my tea refilled.  Great place over all.
My favorite pizza by far in Austin. I like most of them but just have to stick to the classic cheese. Hits the spot every time. Also, the tiramisu here is so good.

the pizza and food here is superb. if you are looking for a nice quality pizza that is worth the buck you are at the right place. additionally the location is ideal to anything that you would want to do in austin.
Best pizza in Austin...their salads are amazing, cool atmosphere. If you're looking for a an Austin-ey place that has great food this is it.

Good pizza, but, honestly, a bit over hyped. Super busy on weekends, so be ready to wait. If you're not overly concerned with how badly your breath reeks, garlic and anchovies makes for some good noms.
Pizza is to thin, and not to much flavor in the sauce

AMAZING AUTHENTIC PIZZA!!! Polite server at the bar seating, the 'white spinach' pizza with the garlic powder topping was to die for!!! Best thin crust pizza I've ever had in my life!!! Our canoli, authentic, freshly made and so rich and indulgent, was complimentary! As soon as we got back to our hotel we immediately regretted only having one slice each. I will never go to Austin again without stopping in for a slice!

Being from Florida I'm used to NY style pizza and this place is the closest I've come to home since moving to Austin. Pizza seemed to be the one thing Austin wasn't doing right but home slice is up threre. I could eat it every week.

My favorite place in Austin for Pizza.  Reminds me of when I lived in Jersey and NYC.  The sausage & garlic or the standard pepperoni w/mushrooms are safe bets.  the cheesecake doesn't hurt this review either.  it is just like NYC.  the only drawback is parking.
Love the Margherita pizza here!

Home Slice Pizza is the bomb! Not only is it right next to The Stag AND in the heart of South Congress, but it is also one of the few places in Austin that does New York style pizza right. THe service is great, all of the employees have been super nice everytime I go in, and they bust out the slices quickly. Even when there is a long line, the wait is never too bad. I highly recommend this place to anyone craving New York style pizza!
Delicious thin sliced new york style pizza. The line was long but it moves fast and the staff is super friendly!
Good pies, long waits. Sit at the bar if you can.  The garlic knots are tasty as well.  Minimal wine list.  Basically, go for the pizza, and you'll be good.
great NY style pizza

If you're in the mood for the best pizza, then Home Slice is your destination. That's my opinion, at least. The place is great, the environment is fantastic, especially when you're making a day of strolling down Congress, Home Slice is a great place to stop by when hunger strikes.

HOLY MOTHER OF GOD!!! I'm a pizza lover.... We stumbled into this plae on a whim.. This is by far THE BEST PIZZA I HAVE EVER HAD! We have gone back many times and there is an extremely long wait everytime we go.  I love bring extra home, I swear it tastes better out of the fridge the next day.  Sometimes the extras will not make it to morning light.  That's how good it is!

Home Slice is always staffed with fun, energetic folks! The pizza is some of my favorite in Austin. Even just the basic pepperoni is great! I have a lot of friends that demand a stop at Home Slice first thing when they come to visit. Pricing is reasonable too.
Cool location. The pizza is thin and new York style. I recommend the margarita pizza, and don't forget to order a pitcher of beer.
grab a slice of pie suckas!!!

I really wish I got to try their food, because the reviews look great. To me though, service is just as important as the food. Due to the 'manager' being an irrational crazy person, I will not be dining here, or at least not without a formal apology. I called last night just before 11pm. The girl answered, and asked if I would be picking up, and I said I would. "Ok what can I get you", she asks. I say that I would like a spinach calzone.. ok everything is good... I would also like a chicken parm calzone. "We do not have that", she tells me. I ask if they have a chicken parm sub. She says they do. "Ok, I would like everything that comes in your meat and sausage calzone, just with chicken parm instead of the other meats- Chicken parm, ricotta, mozzarella, and dipping marinara on the side." Sounds delicious right? So, this girl says she cannot do it and  I ask to speak with a manager.  I hold for a minute, somebody picks up, and says "Hello", I say, "Hi, I would like to ord...." Back on hold without a  word! Some lady then gets on the phone without introducing herself. I say,'Hi, you guys have chicken parm sub..." She stops me right there and snaps back- "WE DO NOT PUT THAT CHICKEN IN ANYTHING ELSE THEN THAT SUB...."   "..but if you guys do a chicken par...."  "WE DO NOT PUT THAT CHICKEN IN ANYTHING ELSE THEN THAT SUB. AND IT IS NOW 11 O'CLOCK AND WE ARE CLOSED!" I then politely tell her, that I was just trying to pay her for food, and that I did not mean to offend her, and for her to have a good night.   When I was a floor manager for a restaurant inside of a NYC hotel, once a guest called room service for breakfast and asked for a banana when we were out of them. The girl that answered the phone, said no we do not have that, and proceeded to politely hang up with the guest. I asked her what that was all about, and she told me that the guest wanted a banana and that we did not have any more. I immediately called the guest back and told her that the banana and anything else she wanted would be right up. I then ran, literally ran, in stuffy August weather, wearing a suit, to the store to get her a banana. Then I came back, and grabbed the rest of the new order, now full breakfast for 2, and delivered the order personally to her room, because it was too early and our room service guys were not in yet. Bottom line is, if you are in the hospitality industry, you do everything you can possibly do to make your guest happy. Happy guests pay you. Happy guests come back. Happy guests tell their friends. Happy guests write great reviews. You have pizza dough. You have chicken. Fry the chicken. Roll out the dough. Egg wash the outside rim. Place the filling on half of the the dough. Fold in half. Place in oven. It is truly that easy. Unless there is really something weird going on, like their pizzas and calzones are all pre-made or frozen. I am paying you.. or tried to pay you for food. Not the other way around.

Since it sprung up on South Congress a few years ago, Home Slice Pizza has quickly become a new Austin institution- so much so that More Home Slice, devoted to takeout and by-the-slice pizza, has sprung up next door to handle the demand.  It has grown a cult following, and sponsors fun events like the annual Carnival O'Pizza, but as for the pies themselves... well, call me a bad Austinite, but from me they get a resounding "meh."  It's certainly not bad, but there are places in town that are much, much better.  Home Slice keeps it pretty traditional Americanized Italian, with a few more creative items like Eggplant Pie and White Clam Pizza, and a decent wine list.  Their ingredients are noticeably fresh, which is often a rarity at pizza places, and the pies are baked to the perfect consistency so they're neither runny nor dry.  Other than that, though, this the pretty nondescript, and the same type of pizza you'd get at any quality Italian restaurant.  They're clearly benefited quite a bit from their ultra-popular location, and a Home Slice meal might be a good addition to a day at SoCo, but they certainly don't merit their own trip.

The first time I went I was not about this place.  The second time I went...to give it another chance, it was much better than the first but the crust was still too crispy and cut the roof of my mouth up pretty bad. I thought though, that since the second time was so much better than the first- let's try again. After all, roof cuts are liveable right? The third time was on a beautiful sunny winter day- it was 70 outside, I didn't have to wear a jacket and I had the day to myself. I tried again. The pizza was perfect and I got a bottle of Dublin Dr Pepper. Yes! I'll be back.

This place is good, but not as great as other places. I know theres a lot of hype because its on South Congress, but I wasn't impressed. Theres usually a very long wait, an hour or more, and i've had better pizza. A lot of people love it, so I say, give it a try. The pizza's crust wasn't as crispy as what id like and the menu wasn't as diverse as i expected. You can do build your own, but at that point, its ah la cart, which is usually expensive.
Best pizza in Austin!!!
One of the best places to go to grab a quick slice. Pizza is excellent and I would recommend it to anyone.
Absolutely delicious! I got a pizza with red peppers, onions, and green olives and I have never had a pizza with so many topping that was still crispy :o I will go back erray
Call for pickup, the message alone is worth it!
Best pizza in Texas!! Every time I come to Austin we have to have our fix at least once
Delicious pizza, always a long line though.

Definitely a signature eatery on South Congress that requires a visit! With quick and easy orders, you have plenty of time to take a sit on the curb and watch the eclectic crowd of tourists and Austinites walk past.  The pizzas are so cheap and larger than you'd expect them to be so they're sure to fill you up or make a great snack now that the food trailers have left SoCo. There's even parking, which is rare for storefronts along SoCo.
A must have local Austin Pizza joint. Located in the heart of SoCo amidst many other great destinations. Try the eggplant parm... one of a kind, lifechanging, and amazing.

This is definitely my favorite pizza in Austin! They always have a really long wait time but it's always worth the wait. I usually get the pepperoni but sometimes I get the margherita which is delicious too. The slices are huge- one usually does it for me! Paired with a Blue Moon and it's the perfect relaxed dinner to have with friends.

It's HOMESLICE!  This place has the best pizza in Austin. Not only is this popular tourist spot serving up delicious food, it's always constantly packed.  If you eat in, be prepared to wait. They have a little patio in the back where you can wait for your table while having a beer or glass of wine.  My only complaints are parking can be very difficult and the lack of a full bar.  Try: Pizza, with your favorite toppings
They definitely make the short list for the best pizza in Austin. I'll still place Saccones as number one, but it's not convenient for most people.
I go here at least twice a week. Can't get enough of this place.

This is one of the most overrated pizza places in town. Sometimes it's pretty good and other times not so good. I love that it has a variety of different topping for pizza, But it's very inconsistent as far as service and quality of food. Quite hit or miss.  Once I went and it was pretty good with the toppings for the pizza cooked delightfully. But more often than not, the toppings are not cooked into the cheese or they are cooked too much and burnt.  I know this place is busy, but that should not affect the quality of the food.
Best pizza in austin!!!
Talk about great, this place is so good there are two locations right next to eachother! the best pizza in town, and great prices. this is an Austin classic.
Home Slice is an Austin, TX staple - everyone needs to go at least once (you'll want to go again).   The food and experience are great and I recommend it to anyone.

Okay I don't care if this makes me cool - I finally gave in and tried Home Slice. The pizza IS good, the crust crispy and the cheese-sauce ratio on the money. It's fairly straight-forward NY-style pizzeria however they do offer some Austintacious frills and fancies, pizza and otherwise, that I actually prefer on the menu as well. Nice wine selection, great Euro beers - check it out.

Home Slice is an Austin staple located in the heart of SoCo!  If you are in need of a quick slice of high quality pizza on the go, walk right up to the window and order away.  Their takeout is fast and the service is great.  If you order ahead on a busy day, make sure you plan your parking accordingly...that area tends to get rather busy.  If you are on foot and exploring SoCo, make Home Slice your destination for a quick bite, you won't regret it.

I know there is almost a cult following for this place, but I'm not the biggest fan of how they do their pizza. If you're doing thin crust, I think the toppings need to really stand out in quality and creativity. I'd say this place holds my average standard for what I'm looking for in a pizza. It's definitely better to dine in than to take it home, but i can't give it more stars because there are other places in Austin that can create a better pizza.
best pizza i have had in a long time. also free smarties

This place is awesome, when your just coming from downtown and your looking for that pizza crazing for a cheap price. Home Slice is where it's at. Just be ready to stay in a long line. Thie pizza is a New York kind of pizza style and they serve by the slice.

This place has the name and the reputation.  Do it if you have never been.  I am not saying it is my favorite pizza in town - just that it is a must go to.   Service is great and the food is high quality.  Pizza is like BBQ you could argue all day about who is the best.
Delicious thing crust pizza, awesome wait staff. What more does a pizza joint need?
Straight talk ... Homeslice is the best pizza in Austin. It's New York style, so hand-tossed non-greasy crust, and the slices are big enough that you can fold it over and eat like a sandwich!
The eggplant pizza is my favorite.
Probably the best pizza I've had since moving to Texas. :)

good pizza, honestly nothing amazing or out of the ordinary, if you crave pizza go, but if time is limited skip it, one pizza takes about an hour to make deliver and box if to go. for the ordinary hangover skip it or else you might die waiting for a greasy pie
The best pizza in Austin!!! They always have great customer service!!!
We had plain cheese, pepperoni, and margherita pizza.  It was all so delicious!  Thin with crispy crust.  I highly recommend!
Delicious. Home Slice is consistently great, fast, and friendly. The crust is flavorful and the staples are as good as the more interesting options.

The pizza at Home Slice is amazing! It has a great atmosphere and great service. I will offer this place to everyone! I took my parents there and had a great time! I'll keep going and going to home slice. I can't wait till i go back to home slice. Pizza, friends, and family are there!
Don't get a salad here, not that you would, but hey I make mistakes sometimes. Anywho, great pies, but long waits.
I asked someone where the best pizza they ever had was...well, it did not disappoint. Had it 2x in 3 days. Tough to park, the ONLY drawback.

Really great pizza. Place is somewhat of a staple here. Nice that you can order available pizza by the slice rather than having to always get a whole pie. Cute branding :) Really long waits usually, so try to catch them at an off hour. I believe they close on Tuesdays, which can be a jam (like craving Chick-fil-a on a Sunday). Maybe they've changed that since I've been there.

OMG!!! Best pizza EVER!!! I LOVE this place!!!!! I have not had better pizza than this! You must try the #6! It's going to blow your mind!  The service is also super great and I always see celebs there. :)
I absolutely love the food and atmosphere. Every year they have a pizza carnival and it is so much fun! If you want great, fresh pizza with the finest ingredients, look no further!

I'm always on the lookout for good pizza and so had to come check out Home Slice.  Loved the vibe and the food, though the pizza had just a tad too much Parmesan. We were seated promptly, even on a busy night, and our food came out pretty promptly.
